description: The OIDC provider's own authentication-session record (its id is the token 'sid' claim). Distinct from the generic Session entity, which belongs to unrelated first-party login flows (e.g. pastebin's own cookie session) — kept separate so no protocol's session semantics leak into another's. System-managed — never reachable through the generic entity API.

id.description: This is the OIDC 'sid' claim value

authTime.description: For the 'auth_time' claim / future max_age support

expiresAt.description: Absolute session ceiling, independent of individual refresh-token TTLs

user.description: User this OIDC session belongs to
